regressions.what: New grass beside the largest rock makes its right flank read as planted dry ground where the target shows open water.

blockers.target: The lake flows into a widening apron of shallow water that occupies nearly the entire bottom edge.
blockers.current: The outlet narrows to a dark strip left of center and dry ground reaches the right flank of the largest rock.
blockers.change: Extend the water surface around both sides of the largest rock and fan it out to about 90% of the bottom edge.

blockers.target: The left bank projects over a steep exposed face and the opposite gravel crescent rises into continuous grass.
blockers.current: Both banks are low smooth slopes with isolated grass clumps and the right gravel patch has a straight upper edge.
blockers.change: Cut a recessed face below a projecting grass lip on the left and curve the right gravel edge up into a continuous grass verge.

blockers.target: The rear-left rock is about two-thirds the width of the largest rock and the front-left rock is about half its width.
blockers.current: The rear-left and front-left stones are both less than half their target widths and the largest rock sits against the bank.
blockers.change: Enlarge both left rocks to those proportions and group all three inside the widened channel.

next.target: Broad olive reflections on the lake give way to a visible gravel bed and narrow white wakes around the rocks.
next.current: Blue flecks cover the lake and a gray foam streak runs down an almost black streambed.
next.change: Broaden and soften the lake reflections, show submerged gravel through the shallows and localize foam around each rock.

next.target: Distinct rounded pebbles of several sizes overlap at the waterline and thin into the grass.
next.current: The gravel has lost its regular rows but reads as a flat speckled patch.
next.change: Add irregularly spaced raised pebbles in several sizes along the curved waterline and taper their density inland.

excluded: Sky, mountains and distant upland terrain are outside the outlet scope.
unverifiable: Still captures cannot establish water motion.
